title: Music license validation gate
description: Implement music license validation in the Safety pipeline. Every storyboard scene's music_brief must reference a track from the licensed library. Unlicensed or unknown tracks are hard-blocked. Integrates into the pre-publish safety gate (AFFI-T-029).
sub_tasks: Define LicensedTrack schema (track_id, title, license_type, source)
Create MusicLicenseRegistry with a seed set of licensed tracks
Wire into SafetyGate.pre_publish_check() as additional gate
Unit tests for licensed/unlicensed/unknown track scenarios
